report_notes: The measurement limit E is a calibration estimate (one host, one day; only the tick term is guaranteed), not a mathematical upper bound. A class that stands was not changed by the calibrated limit; it is not immune to every measurement error.

Per-operation timing (K1, V2, V3 workload_wall_ns; L3 churn) also removes overlap between consecutive operations; the effect depends on the operation and is not quantified (listed per metric in not_in_limit).
Preemption, interrupts, frequency changes and client scheduling or wake-up delays are not bounded by E; they act on both arms and enter the pair dispersion.
